messages:
alex_sales: Quick handoff for HarborHealth — they signed EAA last week, want VPC private deployment + SSO (Okta). Sales collected initial security questionnaires. Goal: go-live pilot with 3 teams by 2026-05-05. Renewal discussion scheduled in 11 months but flagged as medium risk because they have PHI and strict compliance needs.

maria_csm: Thanks Alex. Key ask: can we get a short context packet (customer goals, success metrics, showstopper list)? I'll own CS kickoff + 1:1s.

alex_sales: Sending here — TL;DR: primary use case is clinical summarization and internal triage; QPS low for pilot (~20 reqs/min) but latency SLO 200ms p95. Main constraints: on-prem model requirement for PHI, KMS/HSM integration, and SOC2 audit evidence. Contact: Dr. Lena Park (IT lead) lena@harborhealth.com, budget committed.

priya_onboard: Noted. I'll schedule a 60-min onboarding playbook session w/ their platform and ops teams. Proposed dates: 2026-04-21 or 2026-04-23. Need: Okta SAML metadata + network egress checklist.

ben_support: Heads up — if they require on-prem model we may need eng assist for quantization/compatibility and certs for our private bundle. @raj_se can you assess runtime compatibility for the model family they want?

raj_se: I can do a quick triage. Ask sales for model artifact (HF repo or tarball) and intended sequence lengths. If it's a large decoder-only model we should aim for int8 quant + KV caching config. I can run a perf smoke test once we have artifact.

alex_sales: @raj_se artifact link: https://s3.redwood-internal/hh-models/harbor_v1.tar.gz (access granted). Sequence len ~1024 worst-case. Also attaching the security questionnaire answers in Drive (link pasted in DM).

maria_csm: Risks noted: (1) compliance docs may delay pilot; (2) SSO config sometimes needs internal firewall exceptions; (3) pilot could expand scope quickly -> budget creep. I'll track these and create a risks tracker.

priya_onboard: Action owners I'm setting: CS kickoff & success plan = @maria_csm; Onboarding ops + SSO = @priya_onboard; Runtime triage = @raj_se; Support SLA/incident runbook = @ben_support. I'll create a shared checklist in the customer workspace and invite the customer.

enablement-bot: Suggested enablement assets: /playbooks/private-deploy-checklist, /templates/sso-onboarding-step-by-step, /runbooks/pilot-ops-runbook.

maria_csm: Next steps: 1) Priya to confirm kickoff date with customer by EOD 2026-04-15. 2) Raj to deliver triage findings by 2026-04-18. 3) Ben to draft incident runbook and escalation path by 2026-04-20. 4) I'll put together success metrics doc and share for review.

alex_sales: I'll follow up on SAML metadata and the signed DPA. Also captured customer feedback from POC — they emphasized low latency and auditability as top priorities.

ben_support: Quick note on SLAs — for private deployments with PHI we should propose a 99.9% uptime target for pilot but keep a contingency window for initial tuning.

maria_csm: Got it. I'm adding a renewal-risk flag in our tracker as "medium" and will revisit after pilot. Any blockers right now?

raj_se: No blockers after I get model artifact. Planning to run perf smoke and post results in this thread.

priya_onboard: I'll DM Dr. Park for preferred kickoff time slots and request Okta metadata + network contacts.

alex_sales: Thanks team — appreciate quick turnaround. I'll stay on thread for any sales-related clarifications. :thumbsup:
